simple.prompt: First Conditional (Real future): If the weather ___ clear tomorrow, we will conduct the drone survey.
simple.explanation: Dalam First Conditional (kemungkinan nyata di masa depan), klausa 'if' WAJIB menggunakan Present Simple ('is'), sedangkan klausa utama memakai 'will + V1'.

simple.prompt: If our startup secures the venture capital grant, we ___ five senior machine learning engineers.
simple.explanation: Klausa 'if' memakai Present Simple ('secures'), maka main clause memakai modal masa depan: 'will hire'.
hints: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + V1.

simple.targetSentence: Unless you register online you cannot attend the conference.
simple.explanation: 'Unless' bermakna 'if not'. Klausa 'unless' memakai Present Simple 'register'.
hints: Klausa hasil: 'you cannot attend the conference'.

simple.prompt: Second Conditional (Hypothetical / Unreal present): If I ___ more free time, I would learn full-stack development.
simple.explanation: Dalam Second Conditional (pengandaian tidak nyata di masa sekarang), klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Simple ('had'), dan klausa utama memakai 'would + V1'.
hints: Pengandaian masa sekarang yang tidak nyata (unreal present).

simple.targetSentence: If she lived in Tokyo she would speak Japanese.
hints: Klausa if: 'If she lived in Tokyo'.

simple.prompt: If I ___ you, I would consult a certified financial advisor before signing that contract.
simple.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku formal untuk Second Conditional (memberikan nasihat 'If I were you'), gunakan subjunctive 'were' untuk semua subjek (I/he/she/it).
hints: Subjunctive formal untuk pengandaian 'andai aku jadi kamu'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Second Conditional memberi nasihat.
simple.targetSentence: If I were you I would accept the job offer.
simple.explanation: If I were you + I would + base verb (accept) + the job offer.
hints: Mulai dengan formula 'If I were you'.
Main clause: 'I would accept the job offer'.

simple.prompt: If you submit the expense form today, finance ___ process it by Friday.
simple.explanation: First Conditional menyatakan kemungkinan nyata di masa depan: 'If + Present Simple (submit), S + will + V1'.
hints: Kemungkinan nyata jika syarat hari ini terpenuhi.

simple.prompt: If our team ___ more free time, we would redesign the entire user dashboard.
simple.explanation: Second Conditional menyatakan situasi khayalan/tidak nyata saat ini: 'If + Past Simple (had), S + would + V1'.

simple.prompt: We won't catch the morning ferry ___ we leave the hotel before seven.
simple.explanation: 'Unless' berarti 'if ... not' (kecuali jika / kalau tidak berangkat sebelum jam 7, kita akan ketinggalan kapal).
hints: Maknanya 'jika kita TIDAK berangkat sebelum jam tujuh'.

simple.prompt: If I ___ you, I would back up the project database before running that script.
simple.explanation: Dalam saran pengandaian baku 'If I were you...', bahasa Inggris standar menggunakan 'were' untuk seluruh subjek.
hints: Ungkapan saran klasik 'Jika aku jadi kamu...'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan mengenai rencana jika hujan turun.
dialogue: Host
What will we do if it ___ during the outdoor reception?
Planner
We will move all guests straight into the glass pavilion.
simple.explanation: Dalam if-clause First Conditional, JANGAN memakai 'will'; gunakan Present Simple ('rains').
hints: Setelah 'If' pada Tipe 1, gunakan Present Simple.

simple.prompt: If Nina spoke Japanese fluently, she ___ apply for the Tokyo coordinator post.
simple.explanation: Dalam hasil Second Conditional (if-clause memakai V2 'spoke'), modal kemampuannya bergeser ke bentuk lampau 'could'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda pemakaian 'would' di dalam if-clause Tipe 2 berikut.
simple.draft: If our branch would have a bigger warehouse, we could store seasonal stock locally.
options: If our branch had a bigger warehouse, we could store seasonal stock locally.
If our branch has a bigger warehouse, we could store seasonal stock locally.
If our branch would had a bigger warehouse, we could store seasonal stock locally.
simple.explanation: Jangan pernah meletakkan 'would' di dalam if-clause pengandaian standar; gunakan V2 'had'.

simple.prompt: If the sensor detects a gas leak, the alarm ___ automatically.
simple.explanation: Zero/First Conditional untuk sistem otomatis atau fakta pasti: Present Simple berpasangan dengan Present Simple ('sounds') atau 'will sound'.
hints: Aturan sistem otomatis yang selalu berlaku.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Conditional Tipe 1 memakai modal saran 'should'.
simple.targetSentence: If the warning light flashes, you should turn off the compressor.
simple.explanation: Tipe 1 dapat memadukan 'If + Present Simple' dengan modal saran 'should + V1' di klausa hasil.
hints: Awali dengan 'If the warning light flashes,'.
Lanjutkan saran 'you should turn off the compressor'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian Tipe 2 memakai subjunctive 'were'.
simple.targetSentence: If the regional office were closer, we would hold weekly workshops in person.
simple.explanation: Situasi hipotetis kini memakai 'were' di if-clause dan 'would + V1' di klausa utama.
hints: Mulai dengan 'If the regional office were closer,'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan First Conditional.
dialogue: Supplier
What if our production costs escalate next month?
Buyer
If the price increases significantly, we ___ to renegotiate the volume quota.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa 'if' memakai Present Simple ('increases'), maka konsekuensi masa depan memakai 'will have to renegotiate'.

intermediate.prompt: What ___ you do if you suddenly discovered an unpatched security breach on the server?
intermediate.explanation: Klausa 'if' menggunakan Past Simple ('discovered'), menandakan situasi hipotetis (Second Conditional), sehingga pertanyaan memakai 'would you do'.

intermediate.prompt: In First Conditional, we can use modals like 'can' or 'may' in the main clause: 'If you complete the task early, you ___ leave the office.'
intermediate.explanation: Klausa utama First Conditional dapat memakai modal lain seperti 'may' (izin), 'can' (kemampuan), atau 'should' (saran) selain 'will'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Second Conditional dengan modal kemungkinan 'could'.
intermediate.targetSentence: If we had more budget we could hire two developers.
intermediate.explanation: If + Past Simple (had) + could + base verb (hire) + two developers.
hints: Klausa if: 'If we had more budget'.
Main clause memakai 'we could hire two developers'.

intermediate.prompt: Provided that the client ___ the wire transfer by 3 p.m., the goods will be dispatched today.
intermediate.explanation: 'Provided that' bertindak sebagai pengganti 'if'. Di dalam klausanya, gunakan Present Simple ('completes').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian dengan 'as long as'.
intermediate.targetSentence: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
intermediate.explanation: Main clause (You can borrow my car) + as long as + Present Simple clause (you drive carefully).
hints: Klausa izin: 'You can borrow my car'.
Klausa syarat: 'as long as you drive carefully'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk hipotetis yang tepat dalam dialog karir.
dialogue: Mentor
Why don't you apply for the regional vice president position?
Manager
If I applied, I ___ have to relocate my family abroad, which I don't want to do.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek tidak berniat melamar secara riil ('which I don't want to do'), jadi ini situasi hipotetis Second Conditional: 'If I applied, I would have to...'.
hints: Situasi hipotetis yang tidak diniatkan terjadi.

intermediate.prompt: You may borrow the studio lighting kit ___ you sign the equipment logbook.
intermediate.explanation: 'Provided that' (atau 'as long as') bermakna 'dengan syarat / asalkan' diikuti klausa S+V.
hints: Maknanya syarat positif yang harus dipenuhi.

intermediate.prompt: Bring an extra power bank with you ___ the venue lacks available wall outlets.
intermediate.explanation: 'In case' berarti langkah berjaga-jaga dari sekarang untuk mengantisipasi kemungkinan situasi ('kalau-kalau tidak ada colokan').
hints: Membawa power bank adalah langkah antisipasi sejak awal.
Bedakan 'in case' (berjaga-jaga) dengan 'if' (syarat terjadi baru bertindak).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi agar Conditional Tipe 1 terdengar lebih tentatif/sopan.
dialogue: Client
What if we order five hundred units at once?
Sales
If you ___ happen to place a bulk order, we could waive the freight fee.
intermediate.explanation: 'If + S + should happen to + V1' dalam Tipe 1 membuat syarat terdengar lebih tentatif dan diplomatis dalam negosiasi bisnis.
hints: Pola diplomatis Tipe 1: 'If you should...' (seandainya saja).

intermediate.prompt: Suppose the train ___ delayed for an hour — how would we reach the port in time?
intermediate.explanation: 'Suppose' sebagai alternatif 'If' pada skenario khayalan Tipe 2 dipasangkan dengan 'were' dan klausa hasil 'would'.
hints: Lihat klausa kedua memakai 'would we reach' (Tipe 2).

intermediate.prompt: She might join the hiking trip tomorrow if she ___ finish her audit tonight.
intermediate.explanation: Pada pengandaian nyata Tipe 1, if-clause dapat memakai Present modal 'can' ('if she can finish') berpasangan dengan 'might/will' di klausa hasil.
hints: Rencana nyata besok dan malam ini.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan 'unless' dengan kalimat negatif di dalamnya berikut.
intermediate.draft: The system won't save your draft unless you don't click the confirm button.
options: The system won't save your draft unless you click the confirm button.
The system won't save your draft if you click the confirm button.
The system wouldn't save your draft unless you don't clicked the confirm button.
intermediate.explanation: 'Unless' sudah bermakna 'if ... not'; menambahkan 'don't' setelah 'unless' membalik makna menjadi positif keliru.

intermediate.prompt: If we ___ a local translator, our negotiations with the Kyoto partner would move much faster.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa hasil memakai 'would move' (Second Conditional), sehingga if-clause mewajibkan Past Simple ('hired').

intermediate.prompt: If anyone calls while I am in the boardroom, ___ a message for me, please.
intermediate.explanation: First Conditional juga lazim memakai kalimat perintah (Imperative 'take...') di klausa hasil.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat syarat memakai 'on condition that'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The bank will approve the loan on condition that you provide collateral.
intermediate.explanation: 'On condition that' berfungsi setara 'provided that' sebagai syarat formal perjanjian.
hints: Awali dengan 'The bank will approve the loan'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian Tipe 2 dengan modal 'might' di klausa hasil.
intermediate.targetSentence: If the café stayed open later, more students might study there.
intermediate.explanation: If + V2 ('stayed') berpasangan dengan 'might + V1' untuk kemungkinan hasil hipotetis.
hints: Mulai dengan 'If the café stayed open later,'.
Akhiri dengan 'more students might study there'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan memasukkan 'would' ke dalam klausa 'if'.
complex.draft: If the company would invest in cybersecurity, our customer data would be much safer.
options: If the company invested in cybersecurity, our customer data would be much safer.
If the company had invested in cybersecurity, our customer data would be much safer.
If the company will invest in cybersecurity, our customer data would be much safer.
complex.explanation: Kesalahan 'would in the if-clause': modal 'would' TIDAK BOLEH diletakkan di dalam klausa 'if'. Rumus Second Conditional yang benar: If + Past Simple ('invested'), ... would + V1.
hints: Modal 'would' pantang ditaruh di dalam klausa 'if'.
Ubah menjadi Past Simple 'If the company invested'.

complex.prompt: Formal Inversion First Conditional (omitting 'if'): '___ you require further technical documentation, please contact our support desk.'
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris bisnis formal, 'if' dapat dihilangkan dengan membalik modal 'Should' ke awal kalimat (Inverted First Conditional): 'Should you require...' = 'If you require...'.
hints: Inversi formal menggantikan 'if' dengan 'Should' di awal.

complex.prompt: Formal Inversion Second Conditional: '___ the board to reject the proposal, the merger would collapse immediately.'
complex.explanation: Inversi formal Second Conditional: 'Were + Subject + to-infinitive' ('Were the board to reject...') menggantikan 'If the board rejected...'.
hints: Inversi formal Second Conditional dengan 'Were... to-infinitive'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi formal Second Conditional.
complex.targetSentence: Were I in your position I would decline the offer.
complex.explanation: Inversi: Were I in your position (menggantikan 'If I were in your position') + I would decline the offer.
hints: Awali dengan inversi 'Were I in your position'.
Main clause: 'I would decline the offer'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan antara tipe 1 (kemungkinan masa depan) dan tipe 2 (hipotetis masa kini).
complex.draft: If the sun rises in the east tomorrow, I would be surprised.
options: If the sun rises in the east tomorrow, I will be surprised.
If the sun rose in the east tomorrow, I would be surprised.
If the sun will rise in the east tomorrow, I am surprised.
complex.explanation: Klausa 'if' menggunakan Present Simple 'rises', maka main clause harus konsisten dengan First Conditional menggunakan modal 'will': 'I will be surprised'.
hints: Jaga konsistensi antara klausa 'if' (Present) dan main clause (will).

complex.prompt: Supposing the transaction ___ disputed by the cardholder, what protocol would we follow?
complex.explanation: 'Supposing' bertindak sebagai konjungsi pengandaian hipotetis ('What if'). Diikuti oleh bentuk subjunctive lampau 'were': 'Supposing the transaction were disputed...'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan inversi formal 'Should'.
dialogue: Client
What happens if our requirements change mid-project?
Consultant
___ any scope adjustments arise, we will submit an addendum for mutual review.
complex.explanation: Inverted First Conditional untuk kemungkinan masa depan dalam korespondensi bisnis formal: 'Should any scope adjustments arise' (setara dengan 'If any scope adjustments arise').

complex.prompt: ___ the prototype to fail stress testing next week, our engineers already have a backup design.
complex.explanation: Inversi Second Conditional untuk situasi masa depan hipotetis memakai pola formal: 'Were + Subject + to + V1' (setara 'If the prototype were to fail').
hints: Perhatikan kata 'to fail' setelah subjek 'the prototype'.

complex.prompt: ___ you require further technical documentation, please contact our engineering helpdesk.
complex.explanation: Inversi First Conditional formal dalam korespondensi bisnis mengganti 'If you should require...' menjadi 'Should + Subject + V1'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan inversi Tipe 2 untuk kata kerja biasa tanpa 'to' berikut.
complex.draft: Owned our clinic an MRI scanner, patients wouldn't need to travel downtown.
options: Did our clinic own an MRI scanner, or Were our clinic to own an MRI scanner, patients wouldn't need to travel downtown.
Were our clinic own an MRI scanner, patients wouldn't need to travel downtown.
Owned if our clinic an MRI scanner, patients wouldn't need to travel downtown.
complex.explanation: Dalam Second Conditional, inversi TIDAK boleh membalik main verb biasa ('Owned our clinic...'); inversi Tipe 2 hanya berlaku dengan 'Were' (to be atau 'Were + S + to V1').
hints: Main verb biasa seperti 'own' tidak bisa langsung dibalik di awal kalimat.
Gunakan 'Were our clinic to own...' untuk inversi Tipe 2.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog formal negosiasi mengenai ungkapan syarat pengecualian ('Were it not for').
dialogue: Director
Could the startup survive without that seed grant?
Advisor
Honestly, ___ that initial grant, the lab would still be operating out of a garage.
complex.explanation: Frasa inversi Second Conditional 'Were it not for + noun' bermakna 'Andaikan bukan karena [hal X sekarang], akibatnya...' berpasangan dengan 'would + V1' (atau 'would still be operating').
hints: Lihat klausa hasil 'would still be operating' (Tipe 2 sekarang).
Ungkapan baku inversi pengandaian tanpa hal X adalah 'Were it not for'.

complex.prompt: In rare polite requests, 'will/would' IS allowed inside an if-clause — which sentence uses it accurately?
options: If you would kindly sign here, I can finalize your pass.
If it will rain tonight, we cancel the garden party.
If he would be taller, he could reach the top shelf.
complex.explanation: Meski biasanya 'will/would' terlarang di if-clause, pengecualian muncul saat 'will/would' bermakna KESEDIAAN / permintaan sopan ('Jika Anda berkenan...').
hints: Cari penggunaan 'would' yang bermakna 'bersedia / berkenan' dalam permintaan sopan.
Bukan merujuk syarat cuaca atau keadaan.

complex.prompt: What ___ happen if an automated trading algorithm misread a currency decimal?
complex.explanation: Pertanyaan hipotetis Second Conditional menggunakan 'would + V1' di klausa hasil berpasangan dengan Past Simple ('misread' /mɪsˈred/) di if-clause.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk pengandaian negatif 'But for' vs klausa lengkap berikut.
complex.draft: But for the quick response of the night nurse didn't arrive, the patient wouldn't recover.
options: But for the quick response of the night nurse, the patient wouldn't recover.
But for the quick response of the night nurse arrived, the patient wouldn't recover.
If not for the quick response of the night nurse didn't arrive, the patient wouldn't recover.
complex.explanation: 'But for' adalah frasa preposisi pengandaian (setara 'Without / If it were not for') sehingga HANYA boleh diikuti Noun Phrase ('the quick response...'), bukan klausa dengan verb.
hints: Jangan tambahkan kata kerja di dalam frasa setelah 'But for'.

complex.prompt: Suppose the city council ___ to approve the tram line tomorrow — how long would construction take?
complex.explanation: Setelah 'Suppose', struktur 'were to + V1' menyatakan skenario masa depan hipotetis yang selaras dengan klausa hasil 'would construction take'.
hints: Lihat struktur '...to approve' dan hasil 'would... take'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi First Conditional untuk email bisnis sopan.
complex.targetSentence: Should you need any billing adjustments, please reply to this message.
complex.explanation: 'Should + Subject + V1' di awal kalimat menggantikan 'If you should need...'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Should you need any billing adjustments,'.
Akhiri dengan instruksi sopan 'please reply to this message'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi Second Conditional menggunakan 'Were it not for'.
complex.targetSentence: Were it not for strict quality audits, defective parts would reach retail stores.
complex.explanation: 'Were it not for + noun phrase' bermakna 'Seandainya tidak ada...' + 'would + V1'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Were it not for strict quality audits,'.
Tambahkan klausa hasil 'defective parts would reach retail stores'.
